sources.title: Meta: change creative fields with Ad Copies API

quotes.text: As of May 5, 2025, developers can make more changes to their ads when duplicating via Ad Copies API.
When making a copy of an ad, you may overwrite fields on the creative spec by using the creative_parameters argument.
If no input is provided, the new ad will be created with an identical ad creative.
source_ad_id numeric string or integer ID of the source Ad, if applicable.
Once an ad has become ACTIVE (after passing ad review), ads may fail to deliver because of subsequent changes to related assets after the ad becomes active.
If post-processing fails, the system sets your object to `WITH_ISSUES` and provides an error in `issues_info`.
Calls on ANY access level are against production data.
For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.

quotes.text: Only solution so far is turning the ad on and off in the meta platform.
